verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Supabase publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at supabase.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains 'openapi' key), and the Management API docs describe programmatic access to organizations/projects, corroborating a real spec-driven API surface. Missing for 10: no first-party docs page explicitly linking/describing the openapi.json endpoint as a public deliverable, and no independent/community confirmation of its completeness.
